context: Fresh Windows 11 system; agent runs install-dsh for the first time with no prior install present
error: install-dsh: install finished but no binaries and no marker file under the install root
fix: Install to the default profile path %LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh (C:\Users\owner\.dsh), copy the release binaries, add %LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh\bin to the user PATH, then verify with a smoke start (dsh.exe starts and exits 0).

context: install-dsh already installed at the default profile path; agent runs install-dsh again
error: install-dsh: second run re-copied files over a live install and broke it
fix: Detect the existing install marker and report 'already installed' instead of copying over a live install; only re-copy when the requested version differs.

context: Owner wants a clean slate: uninstall the current install-dsh then install again from the same release package
error: install-dsh: uninstall left the service and profile behind; the reinstall conflicted with the stale state
fix: Run the uninstall step (stop + remove the DSH service, remove the profile directory and PATH entry) before installing; verify the profile directory is gone, then run the normal install.

context: Agent installs with defaults; the profile path must resolve consistently for the current user
error: install-dsh: profile path resolution differed between install root, PATH entry and service config
fix: Use %LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh as the single source of truth for the install root and record the resolved path in the install marker so later steps (PATH, service) use the same path.

context: After the file copy stage completes, the agent smoke-tests the new dsh binary
error: install-dsh: smoke start of dsh.exe returned a nonzero exit code
fix: Launch dsh.exe once with a short timeout and treat a clean exit (code 0) as the smoke-pass signal; on any nonzero exit, fail the install and surface the captured stderr.

context: Install target C:\Users\owner\.dsh is EFS-encrypted; plain copy stage fails on the first binary
error: CopyFileEx failed for C:\Users\owner\.dsh\bin\dsh.exe: EFS error 1314 (missing privilege)
fix: Probe the profile directory for EFS encryption before copying (fsutil or GetFileAttributes with FILE_ATTRIBUTE_ENCRYPTED); when encrypted, copy with raw file IO plus an EFS decryption handle (OpenEncryptedFileRaw/ReadEncryptedFileRaw) so the written bytes are plaintext on disk.

context: Install reports success, but the verify stage reads the installed binary back and gets ciphertext instead of the PE header
error: verify stage: read-back of C:\Users\owner\.dsh\bin\dsh.exe returned encrypted bytes
fix: Never verify a file copied into an EFS directory with plain ReadFile; verify through an EFS decryption handle (OpenEncryptedFileRaw + ReadEncryptedFileRaw) and compare against the expected PE header/size.

context: Pre-install probe stage: agent must decide the copy strategy before touching any file
error: install-dsh: no EFS probe ran; the copy stage used plain CopyFileEx and failed on the encrypted profile
fix: Run the EFS detection probe before the copy stage and switch strategy based on the result: encrypted profile -> decrypted raw copy; otherwise plain CopyFileEx. Record the probe result in the install log.

context: EFS-encrypted install target; the agent applies the decrypted-copy strategy end to end
error: CopyFileEx on the EFS-encrypted target fails with EFS error 1314 (missing privilege)
fix: Copy each file with raw file IO through an EFS decryption handle, write to a temp file in the target directory, then move into place; verify with a decryption-handle read. The on-disk bytes must be plaintext.

context: C:\Users\owner\AppData\Roaming\dsh is a directory junction to C:\tools\dsh; the naive copier follows it and writes the binaries to the wrong target
error: copy stage: junction C:\Users\owner\AppData\Roaming\dsh -> C:\tools\dsh followed; files landed on wrong target
fix: Resolve junctions and symbolic links (fsutil reparsepoint / DeviceIoControl FSCTL_GET_REPARSE_POINT) for every path component before choosing the install root, and copy to the resolved target path only.

context: Install root contains junction pairs A -> B and B -> A; the recursive copier enters an infinite loop
error: copy stage: junction loop A -> B -> A caused infinite recursion
fix: Make directory traversal loop-safe: keep a visited set of resolved (canonical) paths and skip any directory already visited; cap traversal depth as a backstop and fail with a clear message if the cap is hit.

context: The install root itself sits under a junctioned directory (e.g. AppData redirected to another volume)
error: install-dsh: install under a junctioned root wrote files to the junction node instead of the target
fix: Resolve the junction at the install-root level first, then install into the resolved target; confirm the marker file lands on the resolved target and not on the junction node.

context: Junction present on the install path; agent applies the resolution strategy
error: install-dsh: copier followed the junction and landed files on the wrong target
fix: Before copying, resolve every junction component on the install path and use the resolved path as the install root; verify with a marker file that the resolved target received the files.

context: Service creation stage: the DSH agent service must be created with a credential whose password contains special characters
error: service stage: sc.exe create failed (error 1069): the service credential was rejected by CreateServiceW
fix: Quote and escape the service credential when building the sc.exe create command (pass the password as a single quoted argument, escaping embedded quotes), and validate the service starts before declaring the install complete.

context: Config stage: writing the service credential into the config file truncates at an unescaped ampersand
error: config stage: service config write failed: unescaped '&' truncated the value
fix: Never interpolate credentials into a command/config string without escaping; write the config through a structured serializer (escape '&', quotes and cmd metacharacters) or pass the value via an argument array instead of a concatenated command line.

context: Service already installed and running; agent runs the service stage again (idempotent path)
error: install-dsh: service stage recreated a running service and interrupted it
fix: Check the service state first (sc.exe query); if it exists and is running, report 'already running' and skip re-creation; only recreate when the service is absent or the configuration changed.
